description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon, and your most recent action was to Cast a Spell from a spell gem.

You take the delicate remains of a consumed spell gem and load it into your ranged weapon as magic ammunition. Overclock Gear, ignoring its usual trigger. Until the end of your turn, the weapon deals an extra @Damage[1d6[force]] damage and gains the arcane trait if it didn't have it already. If the spell dealt a different type of damage, the Strike deals this type of damage instead (or your choice of one type of damage if the spell dealt multiple types of damage).
